body:
**Verification:** Production testing is done. Smoke tested the Email is Bounced in Saleshandy trigger on Production, all 9 checks:

| # | Activity | What was checked | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Create a Lead in Salesforce | Real bounce, last name with an apostrophe. The Emails tab shows Bounced. One Lead is created with the mapped values as entered, Status "Open - Not Contacted". | Pass |
| 2 | Update a Lead + Record (log) an Email Activity in Salesforce | With a Lead that has an old Job Title, Phone and Company, the mapped values show the prospect's, still one Lead. One completed Email Task on the Lead. | Pass |
| 3 | Create a Contact + Attach Note in Salesforce | One Contact with Name, Email, Business Phone, Department and Other City, and no Lead. One Note on the Contact. | Pass |
| 4 | Update a Contact in Salesforce | Phone and Department show the prospect's values, still one Contact. | Pass |
| 5 | Create a Account in Salesforce | One Account named like the prospect's full name, with Billing City, State, Country and Website. | Pass |
| 6 | Update a Account in Salesforce | With an Account named like the prospect's full name, the mapped values (Phone, City) show the prospect's, still one Account. | Pass |
| 7 | Create a Opportunity in Salesforce | One Opportunity named with the prospect's email, linked to the Contact, Close Date 7 days out, Stage Prospecting, Amount 12000. | Pass |
| 8 | Update a Opportunity in Salesforce | With 3 Opportunities on the Contact, the newest gets Stage Qualification and Close Date 14 days out, the other two are unchanged. | Pass |
| 9 | Closing date 0 Days (AL-4168) | In the Create a Opportunity and Update a Opportunity modals, the field turns red and Save is disabled. | Pass |
waitingFor: QA to send via npm run jira. Source: Email is Bounced in Saleshandy (Salesforce) Production smoke run 2026-11-05, sequence 992146, account emailopenedprod, dev org saleshandy-dev-ed. 9 of 9 checks passed at least once (Check 9 passed after a script fix). QA approved the wording.
